newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Jan 27 - Durres - Six vessels in port discharging of which 1 nitrate, 1 wheat flour, 2 wheat, 1 general cargo, 1 potatoes. Vessels awaiting berth in roads, 1 wheat flour, 1 fish meal, 1 general, 1 wheat, 1 rice.

BULGARIA, Jan 27 - Varna - East - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 awaiting orders. West - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bourgas - East - 15 Vessels due, 8 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repairs/dry-dock. West - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 tanker in port. Varna - 33 Vessels operating of which 15 loading, 4 soda, 4 fertiliser, 3 sas, 1 plywood, 2 clinker, 1 cigarettes. 8 Discharging, 2 sugar, 1 rice, 1 granite, 2 phosphorite, 1 coal, 1 cars. 8 discharging/lo

CROATIA, Jan 27 - Rasa - One vessel loading at berth. Rijeka - Vessels discharging at berth, 4 loading at berth, 4 under repairs/dry-dock, 2 berthed inoperative, 3 anchored, 6 due and delays expected. Split - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 1 under repairs/dry-dock. Pula, Zadar, Sibenik, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels in ports.

CYPRUS, 28 Jan - Limassol - Vessels due on 29/1, 4 container vessels, 2 conventional vessels, 2 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 4 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due on 29/1, 1 container vessel, 2 conventional vessels, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth.

ESTONIA - Jan 27 - City port - 3 Vessels due. 3 Vessels loading at berth (2 map, 1 steel billets), 1 vessel discharging anode blocks at berth, 1 liner vessel. Kopli - 3 Vessels due, 1 loading sulphate at berth, 2 discharging at berth (1 meat, 1 cocoa beans). Muuga - 2 Vessels loading fuel oil at berth, 3 loading at berth (1 peat, 1 sawn timber, 1 general cargo. Parnu - 6 Vessels due, 14 loading at berth of which 8 timber, 4 peat, 2 briquettes.

ITALY, Jan 28 - Naples - One gas tanker to berth on 29/1 or 30/1. Gaeta - One freezer berthed. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 51 Vessels berthed, 4 vessels in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 6 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 9 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, 32 berthed.

Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays. Syracuse oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch - No vessels in roads. Taranto - Three vessels in roads. Ravenna - Ten vessels in roads. Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays, 2 vessels in oil harbour. Venice - Six vessels in roads.

LATVIA,Jan 28 - Ventspils - Eight vessels in port of which 5 operating, 2 steel loaders, 1 each steel billets, alumina loader, mop loader, 3 vessels awaiting instructions. No delays, 9 vessels due. Riga - 17 Vessels in port of which 16 operating, 6 timber loaders, 3 cotton loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 metal loaders, 1 tanker, 2 fish dischargers, 1 vessel awaiting operations. No delays, 19 vessels due. Liepaja - Nine vessels operating, no delays, 1 vessel due.

LITHUANIA, Jan 28 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 oil, 3 fertiliser, 2 steel coils, 1 metal, 1 sunflower pellets, 1 timber, 1 cement, 1 other. Discharging, 2 fish, 2 fish powder, 1 bananas, 1 soya pellets. 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 5 vessels in roads, 28 due.

POLAND, Jan 28 - Szczecin - 82 Vessels due, 41 loading at berth, 32 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 10 Vessels under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Gdynia - 14 Vessels operating, 1 grain awaiting turn, 6 vessels loading at berth (5 general cargo, 1 coal). 8 Discharging at berth (1 coal, 5 general cargo, 2 grain). 5 Vessels under repairs, 24 due. Gdansk - 11 Vessels operating, 7 loading at berth (1 bulk, 2 coal, 4 general cargo), 4 discharging at berth (1 grain, 1 bulk, 2 general cargo), 3 under repair/drydock, 16 due.
PORTUGAL, Jan 27 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 8 general cargo, 2 container vessels, no vessels awaiting berth, places vacant. 5 Piers with cranes, 2 without cranes.

Jan 28 - Setubal - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 13 discharging at berth, 8 under repair/drydock. Vessels for discharging, 4 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 discharging coal, 2 loading butane/propane. Vessels waiting in port, 1 each to discharge coal, chemical naphtha, 2 to load unleaded gasoline, 1 each to load cargo, fuel oil, gasoil, gasoline, jet fuel. Vessels due, 1 to discharge crude oil, 1 to load aromatics mixture, 1 to load propylene.

RUSSIA, Jan 27 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 29 Vessels operating of which loading, 8 non-ferrous, 1 fertiliser, 1 general cargo, 1 container vessel, 2 timber, 3 cellulose, 2 coal, 1 tubes. Discharging, 1 frozen meat, 3 containers, 1 rice, 2 frozen chicken, 1 bananas. 7 Vessels waiting, 11 due. Kaliningrad - Six vessels operating in port of which 2 urea loaders, 1 each coal, ferrous, sunflower seeds, paper loaders. No delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - One vessel operating, no delays, 4 vessels due.

FAR EAST ports - Vladivostok - 10 Vessels in port of which 1 passenger. 5 Vessels loading (2 metal, 2 timber, 1 container), 4 waiting. Nakhodka - 11 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (4 metal, 3 timber), 1 general cargo discharging, 3 vessels waiting. Vostochniy - Eight vessels in port of which 3 loading (2 coal, 1 timber), 3 containers discharging/loading, 2 vessels waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading metal. Zarubino - No vessels in port. No delays or congestion in ports.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 17 Vessels operating of which 14 loading, 1 pipes, 6 steel, 1 scrap, 1 aluminum, 4 paper, 1 seeds. Discharging, 1 various, 1 rice, 1 sbm. 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 2 steel, 1 molasses, 1 coal, 1 paper, 1 lead, 1 copper cathodes, 6 to discharge, 1 sugar, 3 rice, 1 fruit, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 cargo not nominated. 38 Vessels due of which 30 to load, 3 scrap, 16 steel, 2 molasses, 2 fertiliser, 1 vegetable oil, 1 saltpetre, 1 seeds, 1 zinc, 1 aluminum, 1 cement, 1 cellulose. 8 To discharge, 1 maize, 2 bagged rice, 1 container vessel, 1 citrus, 1 vegetable oil, 1 equipment, 1 luggage, oil terminal. 2 Tankers loading of which 1 crude, 1 fuel o

Jan 28 - NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - 8 Vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 2 steel, 1 non-ferrous metal, 5 alumina dischargers, 1 apatite loader waiting. 9 Vessels due during the week of which 8 loaders (2 apatite, 1 coal, 1 scrap, 1 npk, 2 non-ferrous metals, 1 iron ore pellets, 1 vegetables discharger.

SLOVENIA, Jan 29 - Koper - 9 Vessels berthed of which 3 bulk carriers discharging iron ore, alumina, soya. 2 Livestock vessels loading bulls, 2 general cargo loading sawn timber, rails. 1 Reefer discharging bananas, 1 ferry loading/discharging. 11 Vessels due of which 3 containers, 3 car carriers, 2 livestock, 2 general cargo, 1 tanker, no delays expected.

SPAIN, Jan 27 - Sagunto - 16 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro discharging/loading, 6 discharging steel products, 2 discharging timber, 3 loading fertiliser, 2 loading steel products. No vessels outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays. Jan 28 Cadiz - 14 Vessels operating of which 4 ro-ro, 1 tobacco, 1 rice, 2 semolina, 1 salt, 1 shipbuilding material. 4 Repairs, no delays. Aviles - Six in port of which 4 loading steel products, 2 discharging scrap, ammonia. Gijon - Four in port of which 2 loading cement, clinker, 2 discharging iron ore, steel. 3 Waiting at anchorage to discharge. No congestion. Bilbao - 27 Vessels operating (3 tankers, 24 dry cargo) of which 17 discharging, 7 loadi

TURKEY, Jan 27 - Mersin - 17 Vessels operating of which loading, 1 apple, 1 cement, 2 citrus, 2 fuel oil, 1 bottles. Discharging, 1 rail, 1 wheat, 1 pulses, 1 general cargo, 1 fuel oil, 1 sodium, both import/export of 1 vehicle, 1 pulses and cable, 1 container vessel. 11 Anchored. Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 2 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 7 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, congestion exists. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, Jan 28 - Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 3 vessels alongside, 1 anchored, 2 due. Containers, 2 vessels due. Grain cargo discharging, 1 vessel alongside, grain cargo loading, 3 vessels due. Tankers, 1 vessel anchored for loading. General cargo, 2 vessels alongside, 1 anchored, 5 due. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 7 vessels alongside. Sugar discharging, 1 vessel alongside. Mariupol - Nine vessels operating of which 6 loading, 2 steel, 1 sunflower seeds, 2 sulphur, coal. 1 To discharge/load alumina,sulphur, 1 to discharge/load containers, 1 vessel waiting in roads to load steel coils. 22 Vessels due of which 13 to load, 5 steel, 3 fertiliser, 1 coal, 2 slabs, 1 clay, 1 slabs,pipe

YUGOSLAVIA, Jan 28, Bar - 7 Vessels berthed of which 2 discharging gasoline, 4 loading steel coils, 1 loading cathodes. Zelenika, Bijela - One vessel discharging gasoline, 3 other vessels, 4 vessels under repairs.
